author: codex seat
status: FROZEN. Committed alone, before any outcome on the evaluation window was computed for it.
question: On a HISTORICAL window, does the CHOICE of exit coordinate change the executable outcome at all, beyond the two fixed horizons already frozen -- and can that be measured without any threshold being tuned on an outcome?

why_this_document_exists_at_all.the_problem: B19B_EXIT_TIMING_POLICY_V1 pins its population to 'the IDENTICAL admissible cell universe as B15M_LIQUIDITY_CAPACITY_V1, which is itself B15L's universe, by the same conditions in the same order'. B15L's universe is built by b15l.load_entries, which selects WHERE t.state='captured' AND o.fork_state='confirmed' and carries lateness_slots. Those are LIVE CAPTURE mechanics: they record which launches a running shadow feed actually caught, in time, on the winning fork.
why_this_document_exists_at_all.why_that_cannot_be_rebuilt: a historical corpus has no captures. Every launch is present whether or not a live process would have caught it, and no lateness or fork-confirmation attaches to any of them. The literal universe therefore does not exist on the B11a window and cannot be reconstructed from it.
why_this_document_exists_at_all.why_applying_b15m_admissibility_is_not_e: b15m.is_admissible tests quote_in == 0, is_payable, and gross_draw >= 1. It is a reserve and payability test ONLY and constrains nothing about entry selection. Applying it per cell reproduces B15M's ADMISSION rule while leaving B15M's CANDIDATE SET unreproduced, so a t0-based population admits launches that were never captured -- cells B15M never had the opportunity to admit or refuse. That violates B19B's 'this study admits no cell those refused'.
why_this_document_exists_at_all.the_consequence: B19B_EXIT_TIMING_POLICY_V1 is NOT EVALUABLE on a historical window. Its single permitted pass remains unspent and this document does not spend it. This is a different study with a different population, and it says so rather than borrowing B19B's identity.
why_this_document_exists_at_all.how_this_was_decided: the codex seat proposed signal_slot = t0_slot as 'the same conditions'; the claude seat refuted it adversarially by reading b15l's selection and b15m's admissibility directly; the refutation was independently verified against both sources before this document was written. The owner chose a new preregistration over declaring the question unanswerable or over reporting a broader population under B19B's name.

population.rule: every curve in the B11a evaluation window that carries a t0 coordinate and a decodable fee schedule. The entry coordinate is t0_slot + delay_slots, the launch-plus-delay rule stated in b15h_prospective_entry.entry_target_slot, applied to every launch rather than to captured ones.
population.this_is_broader_than_b15m_and_that_is_st: this universe includes launches a live process would have missed: uncaptured, late, or fork-orphaned entries. It is therefore strictly MORE inclusive than B15M's, and its figures are NOT comparable to B15L's or B15M's, are not a continuation of them, and may never be presented as such.
population.the_direction_of_the_bias_is_declared_in: for a NEGATIVE result this population is conservative: it grants opportunities a live bot could not have taken, so a rule that fails here also fails on any subset a live feed could actually capture. For a POSITIVE result it is OPTIMISTIC in exactly the same way, and any positive figure below must be read as an upper bound that no live system could attain. This asymmetry is stated before any outcome so it cannot be invoked selectively afterwards.
population.admissibility: b15m.is_admissible is applied per cell, unchanged and by call rather than by restatement, so a cell whose observed reserves cannot pay for its exit is refused exactly as it is in B15M.
population.development_vs_evaluation: runs against the burned corpus are DEVELOPMENT ONLY and may never be reported as an evaluation result.

inherited_whole: frozen_exit_rules -- all eight, in order, none added, removed, reordered or retuned
frozen_inputs_unchanged -- entry delays (1, 2, 4), position 100000000 lamports, the three cost scenarios
right_censoring -- a rule that never triggers leaves the cell RIGHT-CENSORED, carrying no outcome, never zero, never imputed, never silently dropped
capacity_gate -- B15M external-only payability at the exit coordinate each rule selects
denominator_and_coverage -- coverage reported BEFORE any outcome figure
outcome_reporting -- exact integer lamports, order statistics by integer index, never a mean
multiplicity -- family size 24, reported in full, no rule selected
determinism -- output identical under any permutation of input rows
everything_else_is_inherited_by_pin_not_.why_by_pin: a hand-copied rule set drifts from the thing it copies, and a drift between two documents purporting to hold the same rules is undetectable by reading either one. The implementation verifies both pins, so a change to either document refuses this study rather than silently altering it.
everything_else_is_inherited_by_pin_not_.what_is_NOT_inherited: population, and only population. No exit rule, threshold, delay, horizon, cost, or reporting rule differs from B19B in any respect.

no_threshold_is_tunable_here.rule: no number in this study may be chosen, moved, or justified by any outcome computed on any window
no_threshold_is_tunable_here.the_only_new_number: there is none. This document introduces no constant, no threshold and no cut. It changes which cells enter the machinery and nothing about what the machinery does to them.

known_at_authorship_time.purpose: so a later reader can AUDIT the fit rather than trust an assurance that none occurred
known_at_authorship_time.b19d: B19D_NON_ISSUANCE_SIGNAL_V1 has been evaluated on this exact window. Its result: 0 of 252 cells had a median strictly above zero; the pre-committed primary cell had a median of -26,928,909 lamports on 311 admitted cells of 3,932. KNOWN, and disclosed here because it is knowledge this author holds that B19B's author did not.
known_at_authorship_time.what_that_forbids: no exit rule, delay, horizon or cost scenario below may be justified, placed, ordered or motivated by B19D's outcome. None was: every one is inherited verbatim by pin from a document frozen before B19D ran.
known_at_authorship_time.b19b_and_b19c_outcomes_on_this_window: NOT KNOWN. Neither has been evaluated on the evaluation window; both passes are unspent. The only B19B execution to date is a machinery rehearsal on the BURNED corpus, from which this author read cell counts, coverage sums and refusal codes and did NOT read any median, order statistic or outcome value.
known_at_authorship_time.window_composition: the window's denominator (5000 subsampled, 1068 out-of-regime mayhem excluded, 3932 evaluable, 3196 with a decodable fee schedule) is KNOWN, having been published as provenance before B19D ran. It is a coverage fact, not an outcome, and no rule here rests on it.

outcome_reporting.coverage_first: cells admitted, refused by code, and censored per rule are reported BEFORE any outcome figure
outcome_reporting.structural_ceilings_first: the number of curves that could yield a cell at all is reported before the family, so a thin result is not read as a weak rule when it is a small denominator
outcome_reporting.not_a_return: no figure is a return, a profit, an expected value or a performance result, and none may be described as one
outcome_reporting.not_a_recommendation: no exit rule is recommended. The grid is reported in full and never chosen from.

status_locks.label: EXIT_TIMING_HISTORICAL_DIAGNOSTIC
status_locks.single_pass: this study reads the evaluation window ONCE. The pass is recorded in B19_EVALUATION_LEDGER.json before any result is written, and a second pass requires an explicit superseding reason with both entries kept.
